steps.en: OCMS works out the type of the owner's ID
steps.id: OCMS menentukan jenis ID milik pemilik

steps.en: OCMS looks up the owner's mobile number and email
steps.id: OCMS mencari nomor mobile dan email pemilik

steps.en: OCMS saves the owner's mobile number and email on the notice
steps.id: OCMS menyimpan nomor mobile dan email pemilik pada notice

steps.en: OCMS chooses electronic notice if a contact exists, otherwise a letter
steps.id: OCMS memilih notifikasi elektronik bila ada kontak, kalau tidak lewat surat

steps.en: The advisory notice SMS or email can be sent to the owner
steps.id: SMS atau email AN dapat dikirim ke pemilik
steps.why_en: The electronic notification job is switched off in the production settings.
steps.why_id: Job notifikasi elektronik dimatikan di pengaturan produksi.
